_description: This schema defines the run summary structure for Phase 4 orchestrator gates. Fields marked [WS-F2] are provided by generator metrics. Fields marked [WS-H] are provided by orchestrator.

_example: LLM budget exhausted: 5 chunks fell back to template
Validation failed for entity user-handler: unrecoverable error

exit_code._description: 0 = all gates pass, 1 = one or more gates fail

_ws_f2_interface._comment: Interface provided by WS-F2 for WS-H integration

GeneratorMetrics.llmPolished: number - Count of chunks successfully polished by LLM
GeneratorMetrics.templateFallback: number - Count of chunks that fell back to template
GeneratorMetrics.budgetExhausted: boolean - True if token budget was exhausted
GeneratorMetrics.warnings: string[] - Array of warning messages from generation process

LLMGatewayUsage.total: number - Total tokens used across all providers
LLMGatewayUsage.byProvider: Record<string, number> - Token usage per provider

tasks: Evaluate all gates (coverage, link, grounding, cost, adversarial, determinism)
Aggregate generator metrics into run summary
Aggregate LLM gateway usage into run summary
Determine exit_code based on gate results

_integration_example._comment: Example code for WS-H to integrate WS-F2 metrics
